note: NPMCM controls fulfillment end-to-end - you confirm an order in your POS, but THEY decide when it gets packed and dispatched, and every parcel they mark "Fulfilled" in their Shipping Summary charges you Shipping Fee + Insurance Fee + Fulfillment Fee, whether or not it ever gets delivered. Since you do not see that process happen, the only independent check you have is this: does every tracking number NPMCM billed you a fee for correspond to a real order you actually confirmed in your own POS? This sheet checks all of them, one by one, by exact tracking number.
caveat: 19 batches checked against your POS by exact tracking number - 6 are 100% clean (every fulfilled parcel matches a real order) and the rest show genuinely unmatched parcels worth disputing with NPMCM.
